title.en: Express any class frequency through ultimate class frequencies

say.en: A survey gives only a few totals: how many are literate, how many are employed, how many are both. From these few numbers we can find every other class frequency. In this lesson: Express any class frequency through ultimate class frequencies.
Complete a 2 times 2 table of attributes.

body.en: Every class frequency is the sum of the ultimate *class frequencies* it contains: $(A) = (AB) + (A\beta)$, $(\alpha) = (\alpha B) + (\alpha\beta)$, $(B) = (AB) + (\alpha B)$ and $N = (A) + (\alpha) = (B) + (\beta)$. Hence $(\alpha\beta) = N - (A) - (B) + (AB)$. Arrange them in a 2 × 2 table with row and column totals.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಗ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಅಂತಿಮ ವರ್ಗ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ: (A) = (AB) + (Aβ), (B) = (AB) + (αB), N = (A) + (α). ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ (αβ) = N − (A) − (B) + (AB). 2 × 2 ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಲು, ಕಂಬಸಾಲು ಮೊತ್ತಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ.

say.en: Every row and column must add up.
Ultimate frequencies add to N.
Draw a two by two table with totals. We know N is one thousand, A is six hundred, B is five hundred and A B is three hundred and fifty.
Row A: six hundred minus three fifty gives A beta, two fifty. Column B: five hundred minus three fifty gives alpha B, one fifty.
The totals: alpha is four hundred and beta is five hundred.
Finally alpha beta is four hundred minus one fifty, two fifty. Check: the four cells add to one thousand.

problem.en: N = 1000, (A) = 600, (B) = 500, (AB) = 350. Find all the other class frequencies.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. N = 1000, (A) = 600, (B) = 500, (AB) = 350. Find all the other class frequencies.

say.en: Let us work this out together. N equals 1000, A equals 600, B equals 500, AB equals 350. Find all the other class frequencies.
alpha equals 1000 minus 600 equals 400; beta equals 1000 minus 500 equals 500.
Abeta equals 600 minus 350 equals 250; alpha B equals 500 minus 350 equals 150.
alpha beta equals alpha - alpha B equals 400 minus 150 equals 250.
Check: 350 plus 250 plus 150 plus 250 equals 1000.
So the answer is alpha equals 400, beta equals 500, Abeta equals 250, alpha B equals 150, alpha beta equals 250.

problem.en: In a college of 800 students, 480 are boys (A) and 300 play cricket (B); 240 boys play cricket. How many girls do not play cricket?

narration.en: Let us work this out together. In a college of 800 students, 480 are boys (A) and 300 play cricket (B); 240 boys play cricket. How many girls do not play cricket?

say.en: Let us work this out together. In a college of 800 students, 480 are boys A and 300 play cricket B; 240 boys play cricket. How many girls do not play cricket?
alpha beta equals N - A - B plus AB.
= 800 minus 480 minus 300 plus 240.
So the answer is 260 girls do not play cricket.
